```{r clean overall table}
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%filter(
    !(Study_ID %in% c("CarTrans-Long-16", "CarTrans-Long-23", "CarTrans-Long-36") &
      str_detect(Visit, "^VX")))%>%
  select(-ISHLT_1990, -ISHLT_2004, -Class_Sup, -Transplantation_risk)
```

```{r prep metadata}
# Rename visits in overall table
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(
    Visit = as.character(Visit),
    Visit = case_when(
    Visit == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
    Visit == "V0" ~ "Baseline",
    Visit == "V1" ~ "Week 1",
    Visit == "V2" ~ "Week 2",
    Visit == "V3" ~ "Month 1-3",
    Visit == "V4" ~ "Month 4-6",
    Visit == "V5" ~ "Month 12",
    grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ Visit, #keep different X timepoints to not create duplicates
    TRUE~Visit
    ),
    Visit = factor(Visit,levels = c("Healthy","Baseline","Week 1","Week 2","Month 1-3","Month 4-6","Month 12", "VX1", "VX2", "VX3", "VX4")) 
  )

# Assign unique sample IDs for each study ID
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Study_ID, Visit, sep = "_"))

# Create annotation table
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Timepoint= case_when(grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ "Rejection Context",TRUE ~ Visit))

list_Timepoint <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Visit, Timepoint)

 list_Timepoint$Timepoint = factor(list_Timepoint$Timepoint,levels = c("Healthy","Baseline","Week 1","Week 2","Month 1-3","Month 4-6","Month 12", "Rejection Context")) 

rownames(list_Timepoint) <- list_Timepoint$Sample_ID
list_Timepoint <- list_Timepoint[, c("Timepoint"), drop = FALSE] 
```

```{r import lab excel}
# Import only lab data sheet from excel file
table_lab_overall <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  here("data", "RNAseq-CarTrans_Long_Clinical Data_ALL PATIENTS_Export.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Lab Data",
  col_names = TRUE
)
```

```{r clean table_lab}
#Previous labeling of EMB3 still gets imported, although it`s not visible in original excel
# Remove double EMB 3 entries
table_lab <- table_lab_overall %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -`Trop T EMB 3`,
    -`CK total EMB 3`,
    -`NT-proBNP EMB 3`,
    -`CRP EMB 3`,
    -`Leukozyten EMB 3`
  )

# -`Date of lab EMB 3` is not found

# Remove _EMB6
table_lab <- table_lab %>% dplyr::select(-ends_with("_EMB6")) #include EMB7 once the entries are updated

# Rename ID to Study_ID for joining with Luminex
table_lab <- table_lab %>% dplyr::rename("Study_ID"= "ID")
```

```{r prep lab}

table_lab <- table_lab %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("Datelab_")) %>% #Exclude date of lab parameters for pivoting numeric values
  mutate(across(matches("_(BL|EMB[0-9X]+)$"), as.numeric)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("_(BL|EMB[0-9X]+)$"),
               names_to = c(".value", "Visit"),
               names_pattern = "(.*)_(BL|EMB[0-9X]+)$") %>%
  mutate(
    Visit = recode(Visit,
      "BL"    = "Baseline",
      "EMB1"  = "Week 1",
      "EMB2"  = "Week 2",
      "EMB3"  = "Month 1-3",
      "EMB4"  = "Month 4-6",
      "EMB5"  = "Month 12",
      "EMBX1" = "VX1",
      "EMBX2" = "VX2",
      "EMBX3" = "VX3",
      "EMBX4" = "VX4"),
    Visit = factor(Visit, levels = levels(table_lum_CarTrans_overall$Visit))
  )

```


# NTproBNP

```{r NTproBNP correlation, warning=FALSE}
# Match Luminex and lab data per patient and visit
  table_corr <- inner_join(table_lum_CarTrans_overall, table_lab,
                           by = c("Study_ID", "Visit"))
# Order Timepoints
table_corr <- table_corr%>%
mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Healthy", "Baseline", "Week 1", "Week 2","Month 1-3", "Month 4-6", "Month 12", "Rejection Context")))

# Define lab parameter (y axis)
  lab_param <- "NTproBNP"
  lab_label <- "NTproBNP (ng/l)"

# Define Luminex analytes (x axis)
  analytes <- c("PD_L1", "CXCL10", "IL2R", "Grem2")
  analyte_labels <- c("PD L1 (pg/ml)", "CXCL10 (pg/ml)", "IL2R (pg/ml)", "Grem2 (pg/ml)")
  names(analyte_labels) <- analytes

# Create list for plots
  plots_list <- list()

# Loop Correlation Plot
  for (p in analytes) 
    
    {
  
      # Compute Spearman correlation
        cor_test <- cor.test(table_corr[[p]], table_corr[[lab_param]], method = "spearman")
  
      # Define x axis margins and breaks
        max_x <- max(table_corr[[p]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
        min_x <- min(table_corr[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
        max_log10_limit <- 10^(ceiling(log10(max_x)))
        min_log10_limit <- 10^(floor(log10(min_x)))
        x_breaks <- 10^(seq(log10(min_log10_limit), log10(max_log10_limit), by = 1))
  
      # Scatter plot with regression line
        plot <- ggplot(table_corr, aes(x = .data[[p]], y = .data[[lab_param]])) +
                geom_point(aes(fill = Timepoint), shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "black",
                           position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0)) +
                geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
                scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors$Timepoint) +
                scale_x_log10(labels = function(y) format(y, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), 
                              limits = c(min_log10_limit, max_log10_limit),
                              expand = c(0.05, 0), breaks = x_breaks) +
                theme_classic() +
                labs(x = analyte_labels[[p]], y = lab_label) +
                annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
                         label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 2),
                                        "\np = ", ifelse(cor_test$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", signif(cor_test$p.value, 3))),
                         hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 4)
        
      # Store each plot
        plots_list[[p]] <- plot

  }

# Combine plots to a panel
  panel <- ggarrange(plotlist = plots_list, ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                     common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right")
      
  print(panel)
```
